category_title: Probationary high school students with severe behavioral challenges and academic resistance
minimal_context: The student is expected to read from their world history textbook during class.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please open your world history textbooks and start reading the assigned chapter.

STUDENT: (Throws a paper ball across the room) I'm not doing this work.

TUTOR: Please stop throwing things and look at your book.

STUDENT: (Tears a page out of the history book) Why are you teaching us bad kids?

TUTOR: We need to get through this history lesson. Please pay attention.

STUDENT: (Pours hand sanitizer on the chair and tries to set it on fire) It's an unauthorized science experiment.

options.A: Direct the student to take a few minutes to calm down during the history lesson.
options.B: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time with the assigned history reading.
options.C: Provide the student with immediate verbal praise and positive reinforcement during the history lesson.
options.D: Instruct the student to trace images from the history textbook, search for related images online, and choose pictures of high interest.
